packagingChanges: Each system has a unique module/import namespace (except already independent ServiceRegistry and LocalCloudManager).
Support launcher fixes its selected role instead of accepting the old generic -system switch.
Generated independent Makefiles, Dockerfiles, deployment templates and folder documentation.
Example JSON/properties mount paths and core upstream origins adapted for standalone container templates; upstream identity names retained.
Core/support shared internal source and original tests snapshotted into each private module without handler changes.
